description: Find key people at a company including founders, C-suite executives, and team members. Scrapes the company's website (e.g. /about, /team pages), checks Wikipedia, and cross-references GitHub org members. Returns names, titles, and sources. Use this when you need leadership or team information specifically. Requires a domain name.

domain.description: Company website domain without protocol (e.g. 'openai.com'). The tool will scrape the site's about/team pages.

name: get_key_people
